summary.intent: Get three review findings on stacked PRs fixed and resolved (two on #410 instantiation probe, one on #411 checker-watch), delegated to a subagent, then verify PR state and report back.
summary.outcome: The subagent fixed and resolved all three findings with failing-then-passing tests and green local gates; the PR status check showed no open findings, no failing checks on #410/#413, and #411 still had 15 checks pending. Merge approval and Entire Gates approval remain with the user.

repo: The probe file is a separate module from the component's file, so diagnostics and printed defaults from it must not be read by line number or name text in the component's file.

Single enforcement point for instantiation identity is `arguments_keep_their_meaning` in `crates/semantic/src/instantiate.rs`; each probe line declares `CaliperSignature{i}` and `CaliperArgument{i}_{j}` and a component is read only if the argument type id equals the signature's declared default id.
Identity is type-id based, so an inline default like `{ x: string }` now falls back conservatively; frequency of this is unknown.

`SemanticHook` in `crates/core/src/pipeline/semantic_hook.rs` now caches an `Answered` (component plus the diagnostics of the request that made it) and replays it on cache hits, including late answers; the unavailable-checker warning stays once per session.
The semantic hook cache is in memory only, so no `CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION` bump, changelog, or golden changes are needed; the binding and `on_demand` cache no component answers.
Only `cases.recording.json` has a probe file, so it was the only recording re-recorded (against tsrs 0.23.0-ts7.1.0-beta); other recordings replay byte-identically.

Gate commands: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `just semver`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked --no-fail-fast` with `TSRS_BIN` set, `just test-checker-lane`, `just test-construct`.
PR stack ordering: #411 (feat/checker-watch) builds on #410 (feat/instantiation-probe), so #410 must merge first.

code.finding: `arguments_keep_their_meaning` is the single enforcement point for the probe-file identity check and falls back with 'a name in its type arguments means something else…' on mismatch; only errors in the probe file (via `FileDiagnostic.file_name`) are counted.
Cache holds `Answered` rather than just the component so warnings/fallback reasons are replayed on each cache hit and for late answers.

Tests use real tsrs; FormData fixture must be `type FormData = { id: string }` since an interface reads as `Named("FormData")` either way and cannot discriminate. The S5 unit test uses an `Anchor` fixture component because production only instantiates at defaults.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output; the main session verified the claim by re-querying PR status and open findings per branch via `gh pr view` and `entire trail finding list`.
Confirming fixes by running new tests against unmodified src (equivalent to stashing) proves they fail before the fix.
When a fix touches a shared root cause, grep siblings (`type_to_string`, `semantic_diagnostics`, `start_position`, `FileDiagnostic`, `.layered(`) to confirm no other call sites share the bug.
Merge the lower PR's fix into the stacked branch first (clean merge `d60e2b7e`) before committing the dependent fix.

friction: Resolving the 410 findings under trail `277` was ambiguous between `caliper/207` and `caliper/208`, so `caliper/208` was chosen.
#411 still had 15 checks pending after the new commits, so its CI result is unknown.
Entire Gates on the PRs requires user approval and could not be cleared by the agent.
open_items: First-answer and RSS measurement (418 to 414 ms from S5) not re-run on these commits.
No changeset added, since both fixes are in unreleased features.
Awaiting user action: merge #410 before #411, plus #410 to #415, #396 and the Callisto PRs (#488, #489, #492), and approve Entire Gates.
Measure how often inline defaults now fall back under the type-id identity check.
